# Function reference {.doc .doc-index}

## Codec

Encode/decode sorted event-time arrays and compress/decompress numpy arrays.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [encode_times](encode_times.qmd#spikepack.encode_times) | Quantize and delta-encode a sorted array of event times. |
| [decode_times](decode_times.qmd#spikepack.decode_times) | Invert `encode_times`. |
| [compress_array](compress_array.qmd#spikepack.compress_array) | Compress a numpy array with Blosc(zstd, shuffle). |
| [decompress_array](decompress_array.qmd#spikepack.decompress_array) | Invert `compress_array`. |

## Containers

Read/write encoded spike trains to disk.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [write_blosc](write_blosc.qmd#spikepack.write_blosc) | Write a spike train to a Blosc directory shard. |
| [read_blosc](read_blosc.qmd#spikepack.read_blosc) | Read a spike train written by `write_blosc`. |
| [write_zarr](write_zarr.qmd#spikepack.write_zarr) | Write a spike train to a Zarr group. |
| [read_zarr](read_zarr.qmd#spikepack.read_zarr) | Read a spike train written by `write_zarr`. |
